issue.title: Agent-hood publication hard-stuck: owner manifest exceeds byte limit for sase-zn/sase-zw; 495 requests quarantined
issue.description:
After `sase stitch create --resume` landed the sase-zn.9 rebase commit (2026-09-14
~09:4x EDT, primary repo master 17ac0d4463), the finalizer warned: this project has 495
quarantined and 36 retired agent-hood publication requests, and the link written to the
new commit may stay unavailable until the outbox clears. The recorded last error is
`could not publish agent hood 'sase-zn': owner manifest exceeds the byte limit` (and the
same for hood 'sase-zw').

So hood publication for at least two hoods is hard-stuck: every retry re-fails on the
same byte-limit check, which is why the quarantine count has grown to 495 — retrying
(`sase agent sync --retry-quarantined`) cannot succeed until the owner manifest for
those hoods is shrunk, sharded, or the limit is raised. Meanwhile each new commit in the
project appends another quarantined request, and commit-page links to agent
pages/prompts stay dead.

Worker should find where the owner manifest byte limit is enforced in agents-sync
publication, why the sase-zn / sase-zw hood manifests exceed it (likely very deep epic
families: sase-zn.9 alone has nested phase agents), and either shard/truncate the
manifest, raise the limit, or make oversized-manifest publication degrade to something
that still publishes member pages. Also decide what to do with the 495 quarantined and
36 retired requests once publication works (`--retry-quarantined` / `--drop-retired`);
I did not run either command since retries currently cannot succeed and dropping
publication requests is an owner decision.

task_type_fields.impact: Commit-page agent links stay dead for every new commit in the project; quarantine outbox grows unboundedly (495 and counting).
task_type_fields.location: agents-sync hood publication / owner manifest byte-limit enforcement (hoods sase-zn, sase-zw)
task_type_fields.repro: Land any commit in the primary sase repo via sase stitch create; the finalizer's publication warning reports the quarantine counts and 'owner manifest exceeds the byte limit' last error. sase agent sync --retry-quarantined re-fails the same way.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction and full root-cause on 2026-09-16 while diagnosing the 404 for agents/bbugyi200.athena.sase-11l.2/README.md. The athena/sase owner manifest (users/bbugyi200/machines/athena/manifest.json in the agents sidecar) is 4,193,856 bytes - 448 bytes under the 4 MiB MAX_JSON_BYTES read cap (src/sase/agents_sync/v2_validation.py:23) - with 2043 hoods and 71,899 per-hood file paths. The cap is enforced on read but not write, so any publish that adds a NEW hood writes the manifest over the cap; the post-write re-read in _prepare_publications (src/sase/agents_sync/commit_publication_transaction.py:258-267) then raises 'owner manifest exceeds the byte limit', AgentsSyncFormatError marks the outbox item terminal, and worktree cleanup reverts the manifest to just-under-cap so the failure repeats for every new hood forever. Outbox for gh_sase-org__sase is now 719 items / 646 quarantined / 71 terminal; sase-11l.2's request is terminal with exactly this reason. Two aggravators: load_validated_publication re-hashes all ~71,899 referenced files on every single-hood publish (215 items failed 'did not complete within 120s'), and manifest decode caps hoods at MAX_CONTAINERS=2048 while the manifest holds 2043 with 2091 hood dirs on disk, so --repair-manifest would trip 'owner manifest has too many hoods'. Key fix lever: V2OwnerHoodEntry.files has exactly one consumer (the cross-check at src/sase/agents_sync/publication_validation.py:95) and is derivable from the digest-pinned snapshot, so ~90% of the manifest bytes are droppable denormalization. An epic plan (slim manifest behind a sunset flag + dedicated larger manifest caps + scoped run-file verification + athena outbox recovery/backfill) is being proposed now to fix this bead.

Relayed from sase-zr.1 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP (note #2, 2026-09-13 19:15 EDT) during the sase-zr landing audit: at sase-zr.1 landing time sase agent sync already showed 56 quarantined agent-hood publication requests plus 'agents sync lock is busy', which deferred that bead's commit-link publication. This is an earlier point on the same quarantine growth sase-10x reports (495 by 2026-09-14) and that in-progress epic sase-11o is remediating.

Independent reproduction 2026-09-25 (research.a lead, Agents-tab finalizer research): the quarantined-publication warning is still live on every primary-repo commit. 13 of 14 builtin@commit stitch stdouts from 17:06Z-20:54Z print 'Primary commit succeeded, but this project already has 56 quarantined agent-hood publication requests' (latest: ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run/202609/25/20260925162657/finalizers/commit/attempt-1.research.stdout, 20:53Z). Over the last 15 days it appears in 143 of 188 commit stdouts. Impact: the warning exists only in finalizer stdout, so it is invisible in the TUI and nobody acts on it; it also makes 'success with warnings' the majority finalizer state, which undermines any warning signal in the planned Agents-tab finalizer UI.
